name.value: Stanford Center for Spatial and Textual Analysis

note.value: The CESTA Research Anthology is an annual publication which showcases the work of CESTA's many research projects, as written by our undergraduate research interns. Every year, several dozen Stanford undergraduates from a broad range of majors and minors join the CESTA community as research interns. Over one or more quarters, these interns collaborate with faculty and graduate students on cutting-edge research in the digital humanities. The capstone for our interns is the submission of a research report under the supervision of their project leads. The Anthology brings together these reports, offering a student's-eye view on the work that's been accomplished at CESTA over the course of the year.
